newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close at record on Labor Law reform.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close at record on Labor Law reform.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed at record highs for the second straight session as President Rafael Caldera signed into law a milestone Labor Law reform, trader said.
The bolsa's 19-share index closed ahead 1.3 percent at 7,844.97 points as 601 million shares traded, worth 18 billion bolivars ($37 million).
Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, meanwhile closed ahead 0.9 percent at 121.73 points. Among traded issues, 37 rose, six fell and one closed flat.
"It's a sign that the government is meeting its policy targets," Bancaracas broker William Boulton said of the reform.

The reform, seen by many as the most significant of Caldera's administration, paves the way for a revamping of Venezuela's decaying social security system and liberalization of the country's rigid labor markets.
